title: Lost Mary BM600 Mad Blue Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Mad Blue Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods mix three berries for a bold fruit blend. Blueberry adds juicy sweetness, Blackberry brings darker depth, and Raspberry delivers a sharp tang, resulting in a rich and varied vape. Each pack contains two 2ml pods prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, giving up to 600 puffs per pod depending on use. With a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw, these pods ensure consistent flavour with no need for refills or coil changes. Compatible with the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod into place and enjoy a layered berry vape from first puff to last.
